Subject: Borealis RFP — assurance pack kickoff

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Borealis is moving to the final evaluation stage and we've received the internal request to validate controls before our security council meeting on 3/8. We've attached the SIG Lite spreadsheet and a short questionnaire specific to our data residency requirements.

Can Redwood provide: 1) a control mapping (SIG rows -> Redwood control ID / evidence), 2) a short list of artifacts we can expect to receive this week, and 3) a tentative timeline for completion (we have a decision gating on 3/12).

Files attached to this message: borealis_SIG_lite_v2.xlsx, borealis-data-residency-q1.pdf

Thanks,
Andrew Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Borealis Analytics
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:45:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Borealis RFP — assurance pack kickoff

Andrew —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. We'll run a short internal sprint to map the SIG rows to our SOC 2/ISO artifacts and surface any gaps related to data residency. Proposed plan:

- Today: intake and owner assignment (I'll own the overall delivery).
- EOD 3/1: draft mapping + list of requested artifacts.
- 3/2: evidence packet (redacted PDFs + diagrams) delivered to your secure link.
- 3/3: short review call (15–20m) to confirm completeness.

Marissa / Karthik — copying to coordinate evidence pulls. Karthik, please confirm redwood-soc2 summary and the ISO scoping matrix are current and attach any diagrams (KMS/dataflow). Marissa, can you pull the SIG worksheet exports and flag any third-party attestations we rely on?

Andrew — we'll attach the artifacts and send a secure Drive link when ready; if you prefer DocuSign for acknowledgement, flag it and we'll include.

-Michael
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:05:21 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Borealis — artifact sprint (owners & asks)

Team — quick intake from Borealis (see thread below). Decision gate 3/12 so we need tight turnaround. Owners and asks: 

- Karthik: produce "redwood_SOC2_summary_2028.pdf" (include scope, trust services criteria mapping, most recent audit period, auditor name). Also assemble the "kms-dataflow-diagram.png" showing customer KV separation and rotation cadence.
- Marissa: export SIG worksheet with our responses and the crosswalk to SOC 2/ISO -> save as "sig-worksheet-complete.xlsx"; flag any controls where we rely on cloud provider or third-party attestation.
- Stephanie: run a quick redline on Borealis data-residency questions and confirm any exceptions; prepare a 1-page scoping statement for ISO applicability.

If any artifacts require legal review (eg. contracts or TPA redactions), escalate to legal but note the timeline. Aim for a consolidated bundle by EOD 3/1 so I can send to Andrew and schedule a 3/2 review call.

Thanks — I can help with redaction if needed.
-MG
